code = '''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    result = []
    for row in grid:
        last = max((i for i, value in enumerate(row) if value != background), default=-1)
        result.append([1 if i > last and value == background else value for i, value in enumerate(row)])
    return result
'''
